title: 'Big Short' Investor Steve Eisman Says AI Has an 'Achilles' Heel' — But It's Too Early to Short the Boom
excerpt: “Big Short” investor Steve Eisman says the AI boom has an “Achilles’ heel”: its enormous dependence on OpenAI and Anthropic. But he isn’t ready to short the...

"Big Short" investor Steve Eisman says the AI boom has an "Achilles' heel": its enormous dependence on OpenAI and Anthropic.

But he isn't ready to short the AI boom yet, because investors lack what he had before betting against subprime mortgages: evidence the breakdown has actually begun.

Eisman Says AI Bears Don't Have the Data Yet

Speaking on Friday's episode of his Weekly Wrap podcast, Eisman recalled that before shorting subprime, his team bought access to Moody's securitization database. Month after month, the delinquency data deteriorated and confirmed his thesis.

"There is no such data set with respect to AI," he said. Both labs are private, leaving investors to infer their economics from funding rounds and spending commitments.

That is why Eisman considers calls for a crash "premature." He remains, in his words, "quite long."

OpenAI and Anthropic Are the 'Achilles' Heel'

Still, the investor sees a real bear case. There "don't seem to be any moats around LLMs," he said, as users switch between models constantly and Chinese open-weight rivals are far cheaper. That combination, he warned, could eventually trigger a price war.

The stakes are enormous. Research estimates cited by Eisman suggest OpenAI and Anthropic account for roughly 70% of AI revenue across Microsoft Corp. (NASDAQ:MSFT), Amazon.com Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) and Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL), and 25% to 35% of their cloud revenue.

Eisman also said roughly half of the approximately $600 billion backlog at Oracle Corp. (NYSE:ORCL) comes from OpenAI.

Eisman called that dependency "huge and quite scary." If a price war undermines the labs' economics, hyperscalers may pull back on capex, and "the entire AI chain goes into reverse."

The IPOs Could Put Eisman's Theory to the Test

"When OpenAI and Anthropic go public, we will have some real data," Eisman said.

Both Anthropic and OpenAI have already filed confidentially for U.S. IPOs, but prediction-market traders expect Anthropic to reach public markets first.

Polymarket gives Anthropic a 90% chance of beating OpenAI to an IPO. In a separate market, traders price a 70% chance that Anthropic completes its IPO before Nov. 1, rising to 85% before Dec. 31.

OpenAI looks further away. The New York Times reported in June that the company was leaning toward delaying its IPO until 2027, and on Polymarket, there's just a 20% chance of an OpenAI IPO this year.

Until Then, the Boom Keeps Running

content_html_zh:

“大空头”投资者 Steve Eisman 表示，人工智能热潮有一个“致命弱点”：对 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的巨大依赖。

但他还没有准备好做空人工智能的繁荣，因为投资者缺乏他在做空次级抵押贷款之前所拥有的东西：崩溃实际上已经开始的证据。

艾斯曼表示人工智能熊还没有数据

艾斯曼在周五的每周总结播客节目中发言时回忆道，在做空次贷之前，他的团队购买了穆迪证券化数据库的访问权限。 月复一月，拖欠数据恶化，证实了他的论点。

“关于人工智能，没有这样的数据集，”他说。 这两个实验室都是私人的，投资者可以根据融资轮次和支出承诺来推断其经济效益。

这就是为什么艾斯曼认为呼吁崩溃“为时过早”。 用他的话说，他的状态“相当长”。

OpenAI 和 Anthropic 是“致命弱点”

尽管如此，投资者还是看到了真正的悲观情况。 他说，“法学硕士周围似乎没有任何护城河”，因为用户不断地在模型之间切换，而中国的开放重量竞争对手要便宜得多。 他警告说，这种结合最终可能引发价格战。

赌注是巨大的。 Eisman 引用的研究估计表明，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 约占微软公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）、亚马逊公司（纳斯达克股票代码：AMZN）和 Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOGL）人工智能收入的 70%，以及云收入的 25% 至 35%。

艾斯曼还表示，甲骨文公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：ORCL）约 6000 亿美元的积压订单中大约有一半来自 OpenAI。

艾斯曼称这种依赖性“巨大且相当可怕”。 如果价格战损害了实验室的经济效益，超大规模企业可能会缩减资本支出，“整个人工智能链就会陷入逆转”。

首次公开募股可以检验艾斯曼的理论

“当 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 上市时，我们将获得一些真实数据，”艾斯曼说。

Anthropic 和 OpenAI 都已秘密提交美国 IPO 申请，但预测市场交易员预计 Anthropic 将首先进入公开市场。

Polymarket 认为 Anthropic 有 90% 的机会击败 OpenAI 进行 IPO。 在另一个市场，交易员预计 Anthropic 在 11 月 1 日之前完成 IPO 的可能性为 70%，在 12 月 31 日之前上升到 85%。

OpenAI 看得更远。 《纽约时报》6 月份报道称，该公司倾向于将 IPO 推迟到 2027 年，而 Polymarket 认为，OpenAI 今年 IPO 的可能性只有 20%。

在那之前，繁荣将持续下去
